mappedContracts.statement: Treat media staging and draft mutation as one recoverable transaction.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate magic bytes, size, dimensions, type, and workspace before upload.
Required media failure blocks the draft unless an explicitly approved degraded plan exists.
Orphaned uploads and partial failures produce recovery receipts.

mappedContracts.statement: Replace regex-first Markdown conversion with a source-position-preserving Markdown AST mapped directly into validated ProseMirror structures.
acceptanceCriteria: Support reference links/images, escaped delimiters, nested syntax, raw HTML policy, frontmatter YAML, and source-located diagnostics.
Round-trip and differential fixtures cover long-form Substack content.

mappedContracts.statement: Expand content, media, scheduling, notes, comments, analytics, backup, and publication-management features only through evidence-backed contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: Unsupported or probe-only features remain accurately labelled.
Empty valid collections are returned as successful empty results rather than schema drift.
Every feature has dry-run, reconciliation, audit, and recovery semantics appropriate to its risk.
